skill_name: Summarize the usage of blockchain in the healthcare industry.
workflow: Blockchain is increasingly being used in the healthcare industry to enable secure and transparent data sharing between organizations and individuals. By providing a secure and decentralized way to store and transfer data, blockchain eliminates the need for third parties and makes sure that all users have view the same data sets.
